clues.kinetics: Food cuts peak concentration by 60% and exposure by 34%. Plasma protein binding is under 60%, and urine carries 96% of the radiolabeled dose.
clues.substance: A crystalline powder with a molecular weight of 359.35 and an aqueous solubility of 26 mg/mL at 20°C.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 150 mg and 500 mg tablets, dosed twice daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for death in complete DPD deficiency and for bleeding with vitamin K antagonists. Contraindicated after severe hypersensitivity to the drug or a close relative; anemia and diarrhea are common.
clues.indication: Adjuvant treatment of stage III colon cancer, perioperative treatment of locally advanced rectal cancer, unresectable or metastatic colorectal cancer, and metastatic breast cancer with docetaxel.
clues.mechanism: Converted to fluorouracil in vivo; its metabolites form a covalent ternary complex with thymidylate synthase, blocking thymidylate and so DNA synthesis.

tell: An oral prodrug of fluorouracil, with 96% of its dose recovered in urine.
